**The Skim Test Narrative:**
> A world-class compiler has been dying in silence for five years. This is not one engineer's failure—it is a symptom of a system. Japan has fallen from 4th to 10th in global research impact—and the decline continues. We call it the Isolation Tax—and every researcher in this room is paying it. Meanwhile, Ethereum's research frontier is rich with unsolved problems—and funding. These are not toy problems—they are publication-worthy challenges in cryptography and formal verification. Our team has already found 20+ vulnerabilities in Ethereum clients—rigorous work gets recognized here. The Nyx Foundation community exists to connect you to these problems—starting today. At DEPCON Hakodate, professors, students, and EF researchers are already collaborating across borders. End the isolation. Start the collaboration.
